note: Original one-line descriptions written for this project by a model-author (claude-haiku-4-5) + adversarial-verify (claude-sonnet-5) workflow, 2026-07-15. Written from the models general knowledge anchored on the harvested signatures; NEVER copied from vendor documentation. A name absent here means the author abstained or the verifier rejected - absent beats wrong.

descriptions.ai_analyze_sentiment: Analyzes the sentiment of the provided text content, returning a sentiment classification.
descriptions.ai_classify: Classifies text content into one or more provided label categories using a language model.
descriptions.ai_extract: Extracts structured data or specific fields from unstructured text or documents using AI.
descriptions.ai_fix_grammar: Corrects grammar and spelling errors in the provided text.
descriptions.ai_gen: Generates text content based on the provided prompt using a language model.
descriptions.ai_mask: Masks or redacts sensitive information matching specified labels from the input text.
descriptions.ai_parse_document: Parses unstructured documents into structured content using document understanding models.
descriptions.ai_prep_search: Prepares parsed document content for semantic search and retrieval operations.
descriptions.ai_query: Sends a request to a specified AI endpoint and returns the response.
descriptions.ai_translate: Translates text from one language to another.
descriptions.approx_top_k_accumulate: Initializes or accumulates state for approximate top-k frequency estimation.
descriptions.approx_top_k_combine: Combines multiple top-k approximation states into a single state.
descriptions.approx_top_k_estimate: Extracts top-k estimates and frequencies from accumulated approximation state.
descriptions.bit_reverse: Reverses the bit order in a numeric value.
descriptions.bitmap_and_agg: Aggregates bitmaps using bitwise AND operation across rows.
descriptions.charindex: Returns the position of a substring within a string, using 1-based indexing.
descriptions.cube: Generates multi-dimensional grouping sets for aggregation, including all combinations of the specified columns.
descriptions.current_time: Returns the current time at the specified precision.
descriptions.getdate: Returns the current date and time as a timestamp.
descriptions.h3_boundaryasgeojson: Returns the boundary of an H3 hexagon cell as a GeoJSON polygon.
descriptions.h3_boundaryaswkb: Returns the boundary of an H3 hexagon cell in WKB (well-known binary) format.
descriptions.h3_boundaryaswkt: Returns the boundary of an H3 hexagon cell as WKT (well-known text) geometry.
descriptions.h3_centerasgeojson: Returns the center point of an H3 hexagon cell as a GeoJSON point.
descriptions.h3_centeraswkb: Returns the center point of an H3 hexagon cell in WKB (well-known binary) format.
descriptions.h3_centeraswkt: Returns the center point of an H3 hexagon cell as WKT (well-known text) geometry.
descriptions.h3_compact: Compresses a set of H3 cells to their minimal representation, combining contained cells.
descriptions.h3_coverash3: Returns H3 hexagon cells that cover a given geographic area at the specified resolution.
descriptions.h3_distance: Calculates the distance in hexagon steps between two H3 cells.
descriptions.h3_h3tostring: Converts an H3 cell ID from numeric representation to hexadecimal string format.
descriptions.h3_hexring: Returns the hexagon ring located k steps away from a given H3 cell.
descriptions.h3_ischildof: Tests whether the first H3 cell is a child of (contained within) the second cell.
descriptions.ip_as_binary: Converts an IP address or CIDR notation to binary form.
descriptions.ip_as_string: Converts an IP address or CIDR notation to string representation.
descriptions.ip_cidr_contains: Returns true if a CIDR range contains a given IP address or another CIDR.
descriptions.ip_network_first: Returns the first IP address in a network range.
descriptions.ip_network_last: Returns the last IP address in a network range.
descriptions.ip_version: Returns the IP version (4 or 6) of an IP address or CIDR.
descriptions.kll_merge_agg_float: Aggregates KLL float sketches by merging them incrementally to estimate quantiles across a dataset.
descriptions.kll_sketch_agg_bigint: Builds a KLL sketch from bigint values to enable approximate quantile queries on large datasets.
descriptions.kll_sketch_agg_double: Builds a KLL sketch from double values to enable approximate quantile queries on large datasets.
descriptions.kll_sketch_agg_float: Builds a KLL sketch from float values to enable approximate quantile queries on large datasets.
descriptions.kll_sketch_get_n_bigint: Returns the count of items that were added to the bigint KLL sketch.
descriptions.kll_sketch_get_n_double: Returns the count of items that were added to the double KLL sketch.
descriptions.kll_sketch_get_n_float: Returns the count of items that were added to the float KLL sketch.
descriptions.kll_sketch_get_quantile_bigint: Returns an approximate quantile value at the given rank from a bigint KLL sketch.
descriptions.kll_sketch_get_quantile_double: Returns an approximate quantile value at the given rank from a double KLL sketch.
descriptions.kll_sketch_get_quantile_float: Returns an approximate quantile value at the given rank from a float KLL sketch.
descriptions.kll_sketch_merge_bigint: Merges two bigint KLL sketches into a single sketch representing both datasets.
descriptions.kll_sketch_merge_double: Merges two double KLL sketches into a single sketch representing both datasets.
descriptions.kll_sketch_merge_float: Merges two float KLL sketches into a single sketch representing both datasets.
descriptions.make_time: Constructs a time value from hour, minute, and second components.
descriptions.match_number: Returns the ordinal position of the current match within a MATCH_RECOGNIZE clause.
descriptions.measure: Evaluates a measure defined in a semantic model and returns its computed value.
descriptions.secret: Retrieves the value of a secret from the specified scope and key.
descriptions.st_addpoint: Adds a point to a geometry or geography, optionally at a specified index position.
descriptions.st_asbinary: Converts a geometry or geography to its well-known binary (WKB) representation.
descriptions.st_asewkb: Converts a geometry or geography to extended well-known binary (EWKB) format.
descriptions.st_asgeojson: Converts a geometry or geography to GeoJSON format.
descriptions.st_astext: Converts a geometry or geography to its well-known text (WKT) representation.
descriptions.st_aswkb: Converts a geometry or geography to well-known binary (WKB) format.
descriptions.st_aswkt: Converts a geometry or geography to well-known text (WKT) format.
descriptions.st_azimuth: Calculates the azimuth (bearing angle) from the first geometry to the second.
descriptions.st_boundary: Returns the boundary geometry of a given geometry.
descriptions.st_buffer: Creates a buffer polygon at a specified distance around a geometry.
descriptions.st_centroid: Returns the centroid (geometric center) of a geometry.
descriptions.st_closestpoint: Returns the closest point on the first geometry to the second geometry.
descriptions.st_concavehull: Returns the concave hull of a geometry, with the lengthRatio parameter controlling the degree of concavity.
descriptions.st_contains: Tests whether the first geometry completely contains the second geometry.
descriptions.st_convexhull: Returns the convex hull of a geometry, the smallest convex polygon containing all points.
descriptions.st_covers: Tests whether the first geometry covers the second geometry without necessarily containing it.
descriptions.st_difference: Returns the portion of the first geometry that does not intersect with the second geometry.
descriptions.st_dimension: Returns the dimension of a geometry as an integer: 0 for point, 1 for line, 2 for polygon.
descriptions.st_disjoint: Tests whether two geometries have no points in common.
descriptions.st_distance: Calculates the shortest distance between two geometries.
descriptions.st_dump: Breaks down a geometry into its constituent single-part geometries.
descriptions.st_dwithin: Tests whether two geometries are within a specified distance of each other.
descriptions.st_envelope: Returns the minimum bounding rectangle (axis-aligned box) of a geometry.
descriptions.st_envelope_agg: Returns the aggregate minimum bounding rectangle of multiple geometries across rows.
descriptions.st_equals: Tests whether two geometries are spatially equal.
descriptions.st_exteriorring: Returns the exterior ring of a polygon as a line string.
descriptions.st_flipcoordinates: Swaps the X and Y coordinates of a geometry.
descriptions.st_force2d: Converts a geometry to 2D by removing the Z coordinate.
descriptions.st_geogfromewkt: Constructs a geography from an Extended Well-Known Text (EWKT) string.
descriptions.st_geogfromtext: Constructs a geography from a Well-Known Text (WKT) string.
descriptions.st_geogfromwkb: Constructs a geography from Well-Known Binary (WKB) format.
descriptions.st_geogfromwkt: Constructs a geography from a Well-Known Text (WKT) string.
descriptions.st_geohash: Encodes a geometry as a Geohash string with optional precision parameter.
descriptions.st_geometryn: Returns the nth geometry from a geometry collection (1-indexed).
descriptions.st_geomfromewkb: Constructs a geometry from Extended Well-Known Binary (EWKB) format.
descriptions.st_geomfromewkt: Constructs a geometry from an Extended Well-Known Text (EWKT) string.
descriptions.st_geomfromgeohash: Constructs a geometry from a Geohash string.
descriptions.st_geomfromtext: Constructs a geometry from a Well-Known Text (WKT) string with optional SRID.
descriptions.st_geomfromwkb: Constructs a geometry from Well-Known Binary (WKB) format with optional SRID.
descriptions.st_geomfromwkt: Constructs a geometry from a Well-Known Text (WKT) string with optional SRID.
descriptions.st_interiorringn: Returns the nth interior ring (hole) of a polygon (1-indexed).
descriptions.st_intersection: Returns the geometry formed by the points common to both input geometries.
descriptions.st_intersects: Tests whether two geometries share any space.
descriptions.st_isempty: Tests whether a geometry is empty.
descriptions.st_length: Returns the length of the geometry along its edges.
descriptions.st_m: Extracts the M (measure) coordinate from a point.
descriptions.st_makeenvelope: Creates a rectangular geometry (envelope) from the given corner coordinates.
descriptions.st_makeline: Creates a line geometry from an array of point geometries.
descriptions.st_makepoint: Creates a point geometry from x and y coordinates, optionally z and m values.
descriptions.st_makepolygon: Creates a polygon geometry from an exterior ring and optional interior rings.
descriptions.st_multi: Converts a geometry to a multi-type geometry (Multi-Point, Multi-Line, or Multi-Polygon).
descriptions.st_ndims: Returns the number of dimensions (2, 3, or 4) in the geometry.
descriptions.st_npoints: Returns the number of points that make up the geometry.
descriptions.st_nrings: Returns the number of rings in the geometry.
descriptions.st_numgeometries: Returns the number of component geometries in a multi-geometry.
descriptions.st_numinteriorrings: Returns the number of interior rings (holes) in a polygon.
descriptions.st_numpoints: Returns the number of points in the geometry.
descriptions.st_perimeter: Returns the perimeter (boundary length) of the geometry.
descriptions.st_point: Creates a point geometry from x and y coordinates, optionally specifying an SRID.
descriptions.st_pointfromgeohash: Creates a point geometry from a geohash string.
descriptions.st_pointn: Returns the point at the specified index position in the geometry.
descriptions.st_pointonsurface: Returns a point that is guaranteed to lie on the surface of the geometry.
descriptions.st_removepoint: Removes the point at the specified index from a geometry.
descriptions.st_reverse: Returns a geometry with the order of points reversed.
descriptions.st_scale: Returns a geometry scaled by the given factors along x, y, and optionally z axes.
descriptions.st_setpoint: Returns a geometry with the point at the specified index replaced by another point.
descriptions.st_setsrid: Returns the geometry with the spatial reference system ID set to the specified value.
descriptions.st_simplify: Returns a simplified geometry removing points within the specified tolerance distance.
descriptions.st_srid: Returns the spatial reference system ID associated with the geometry.
descriptions.st_startpoint: Returns the first point of a line or ring geometry.
descriptions.st_touches: Tests whether two geometries touch at one or more points without overlapping.
descriptions.st_transform: Transforms the geometry to a different spatial reference system identified by the SRID.
descriptions.st_translate: Returns a geometry translated (moved) by the specified distance along x, y, and optionally z axes.
descriptions.st_union: Returns the geometric union of two geometries.
descriptions.st_union_agg: Aggregates the union of all geometries in a column into a single geometry.
descriptions.st_within: Tests whether the first geometry is completely within the second geometry.
descriptions.st_x: Extracts the X coordinate from a point.
descriptions.st_xmax: Returns the maximum X coordinate of the geometry's bounding box.
descriptions.st_xmin: Returns the minimum X coordinate of the geometry's bounding box.
descriptions.st_y: Extracts the Y coordinate from a point.
descriptions.st_ymax: Returns the maximum Y coordinate of the geometry's bounding box.
descriptions.st_ymin: Returns the minimum Y coordinate of the geometry's bounding box.
descriptions.st_z: Extracts the Z coordinate from a point.
descriptions.st_zmax: Returns the maximum Z coordinate value of a geospatial object.
descriptions.st_zmin: Returns the minimum Z coordinate value of a geospatial object.
descriptions.table_changes: Returns change data capture records from a Delta table between specified versions or timestamps.
descriptions.theta_difference: Returns a theta sketch representing elements in the first sketch but not in the second.
descriptions.theta_intersection: Returns a theta sketch representing elements common to both input sketches.
descriptions.theta_intersection_agg: Aggregates theta sketches by computing their intersection over a set of rows.
descriptions.theta_sketch_agg: Aggregates distinct values into a theta sketch for cardinality estimation.
descriptions.theta_sketch_estimate: Returns the cardinality estimate from a theta sketch.
descriptions.theta_union: Returns a theta sketch representing elements present in either or both input sketches.
descriptions.theta_union_agg: Aggregates theta sketches by computing their union over a set of rows.
descriptions.time_from_micros: Creates a time value from an integer representing microseconds since midnight.
descriptions.time_from_millis: Creates a time value from an integer representing milliseconds since midnight.
descriptions.time_from_seconds: Creates a time value from an integer representing seconds since midnight.
descriptions.time_to_micros: Converts a time value to the number of microseconds since midnight.
descriptions.time_to_millis: Converts a time value to the number of milliseconds since midnight.
descriptions.time_to_seconds: Converts a time value to the number of seconds since midnight.
descriptions.timestampadd: Adds a time interval to a timestamp and returns the resulting timestamp.
descriptions.timestampdiff: Returns the difference between two timestamps as an integer in the specified unit.
descriptions.try_ip_as_binary: Converts an IP address or CIDR notation to binary form, returning null on invalid input.
descriptions.try_ip_as_string: Converts an IP address or CIDR notation to string representation, returning null on failure.
descriptions.try_secret: Retrieves a secret from Databricks secret storage, returning null if the secret does not exist.
descriptions.try_to_time: Converts a string or expression to a time value with optional format, returning null on failure.
descriptions.try_zstd_decompress: Decompresses data using the ZSTD algorithm, returning null if decompression fails.
descriptions.tuple_difference_double: Returns a tuple sketch representing elements in the first sketch but not in the second with double summaries.
descriptions.tuple_difference_integer: Returns a tuple sketch representing elements in the first sketch but not in the second with integer summaries.
descriptions.tuple_intersection_agg_double: Aggregates tuple sketches by computing their intersection with double-type summaries over rows.
descriptions.tuple_intersection_agg_integer: Aggregates tuple sketches by computing their intersection with integer-type summaries over rows.
descriptions.tuple_intersection_double: Returns a tuple sketch representing key-value pairs common to both sketches with double summaries.
descriptions.tuple_intersection_integer: Returns a tuple sketch representing key-value pairs common to both sketches with integer summaries.
descriptions.tuple_sketch_summary_double: Returns summary statistics as a double from a tuple sketch containing numeric summaries.
descriptions.tuple_sketch_summary_integer: Returns summary statistics as an integer from a tuple sketch containing numeric summaries.
descriptions.tuple_sketch_theta_double: Extracts the theta (inclusion probability threshold) value from a tuple sketch as a double.
descriptions.tuple_union_agg_double: Aggregates unions of tuple sketches across rows to combine approximate summaries with double-typed data.
descriptions.tuple_union_agg_integer: Aggregates unions of tuple sketches across rows to combine approximate summaries with integer-typed data.
descriptions.tuple_union_double: Returns the union of two tuple sketches, combining their approximate summaries of double-typed data.
descriptions.tuple_union_integer: Returns the union of two tuple sketches, combining their approximate summaries of integer-typed data.
descriptions.vector_avg: Computes the element-wise average of a collection of vectors.
descriptions.vector_inner_product: Computes the inner (dot) product of two vectors.
descriptions.vector_l2_distance: Computes the Euclidean (L2) distance between two vectors.
descriptions.vector_norm: Computes the norm (magnitude) of a vector, with optional degree parameter to specify which norm to compute.
descriptions.vector_normalize: Scales a vector to unit length, with optional degree parameter specifying the normalization method.
descriptions.vector_sum: Computes the element-wise sum of a collection of vectors.
descriptions.zstd_compress: Compresses data using the Zstandard (zstd) algorithm, with optional compression level and streaming mode parameters.
descriptions.zstd_decompress: Decompresses data that was compressed with the Zstandard (zstd) algorithm.
